title: Rav Ada son of Rav Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 62a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.62a.12), raising an objection to Rav Ashi. Hyman reports Rav Acha son of Rav Avya in the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim. He explains the absence of Rav Ada son of Rav Avya from Yuchasin by suggesting that it followed the Rif’s reading.

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Rav Ada son of Rav Avya asks Rav Ashi to distinguish a gazlan from a ḥamsan. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=228&lang=en) gives Rav Ada son of Rav Avya a cross-reference under Rav Acha. The reading in the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim and the explanation of the omission in Yuchasin are Hyman’s reports.
